chapter: Tick Chambers and the Dodds brothers
title: Relation to the Dodds brothers and their start in music
summary: Johnny Dodds's brother Willie married Joe's mother, making them uncles by marriage; Baby and Johnny took up drums and clarinet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: No, I'll tell you, he played on a style like Buddy P.T., right? On a style like Schalke played, he was that kind of trumpet player. A real nice trumpet player. And he stayed around Chicago, he stayed around Chicago and died. He left here and never did come back. Never came back. Never did come back to New Orleans anymore. Just like my uncle, both of my uncles, Johnny Dodds, he left and his uncle through second marriage.
I was going to ask you how they were related. Baby once mentioned something about it, too. I didn't know just how you were related.

Yeah, well, see, they're the oldest brother, Willie. They married, he married my mother. After my father and mother separated. He married my mother and that was his second marriage and that's how we got to, you know, his uncle through marriage.
